title: profile_csv_structure input
$comment: Raw transport constraints: one UTF-8 JSON object; input at most262144bytes, output at most524288bytes including newline. Duplicate object keys, nonfinite numbers, unpaired Unicode surrogates, decoded depth>8 or more than50000 decoded values refuse. JSON numeric tokens are at most128characters and must represent exact integers within+-1000000000000; integral decimal/exponent spellings are accepted. Structural schemas do not encode byte ceilings or stated cross-field conditions.
description: Explicit dialect only; up to1000 CSV records including header,64fields per record,4096characters per field. CSV parse errors refuse; ragged rows and exact duplicate/blank headers are reported. Row indices are zero-based data-row positions. Width and column summaries cover data rows; baseline width comes from header or first record. Column_count/columns use baseline width only; extra fields remain visible in width reports. Empty/blank means exact empty string, not whitespace. Duplicate headers use exact case-sensitive equality. When header=true, a CSV record must exist and its parsed field list must contain at least one field; empty CSV and an empty first parsed record([]) refuse. A one-field header with an empty name is allowed and reported as blank.
